---
title: "Original_averaged"
output: html_document
date: "2026-03-20"
---

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(motifmatchr)
library(BiocParallel)
library(chromVARmotifs)
library(chromVAR)
library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(hexbin)

motifs <- chromVARmotifs::encode_pwms
rse <- readRDS("sce.rds")
register(SerialParam())
rse <- addGCBias(rse, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
motif_ix <- matchMotifs(motifs, rse, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
set.seed(123)
bg <- getBackgroundPeaks(rse, niterations=100)
dev1 <- computeDeviations(object = rse, annotations = motif_ix, background_peaks=bg)
bg <- getBackgroundPeaks(rse, niterations=100)
dev2 <- computeDeviations(object = rse, annotations = motif_ix, background_peaks=bg)

d <- data.frame(seed1=as.numeric(as.matrix(assay(dev1))), seed2=as.numeric(as.matrix(assay(dev2))))
cors <- c(deviations=cor(d$seed1,d$seed2,use="pairwise"))
hexD <- hexbin(d$seed1, d$seed2, xbins = 100)
d <- data.frame(seed1=as.numeric(as.matrix(assay(dev1,"z"))), seed2=as.numeric(as.matrix(assay(dev2,"z"))))
cors <- c(cors, "z-scores"=cor(d$seed1,d$seed2,use="pairwise"))
hexZ <- hexbin(d$seed1, d$seed2, xbins = 100)

cors <- data.frame(assay=names(cors), cor=paste0("r=",round(cors,3)))

hex_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(list("deviations"=hexD, "z-scores"=hexZ), \(hd){
  data.frame(hcell2xy(hd), count = hd@count)
}), .id="assay")

save(hex_df, cors, file="original_seed_comparisons_hex.RData")


dev <- SummarizedExperiment(list(deviations=(assay(dev1)+assay(dev2))/2,
                                 z=(assay(dev1,"z")+assay(dev2,"z"))/2),
                            colData=colData(dev1), rowData=rowData(dev1))
saveRDS(dev, "original_averaged.rds")

```
